description: The plot illustrates the hidden state mean for different conditions across layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 24, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5, with tick labels at intervals of 1. A blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate," starting at approximately 0.4 at layer 0 and increasing to approximately 4.3 at layer 24, with a peak at approximately 0.65 at layer 10 and a decline to approximately 0.5 at layer 15. An orange dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate," starting at approximately 0.05 at layer 0 and remaining relatively constant at approximately 0.02 until layer 24, where it reaches approximately 0.06. A green solid line represents the "hidden state mean of baseline," starting at approximately 0.02 at layer 0 and remaining relatively constant at approximately 0.01 until layer 24, where it reaches approximately 0.02.
